svg.title: Payroll and finance: how the pieces fit — SoftTrack web design mockup (#136)
svg.desc: A map of the payroll and finance epic: the Finance section only finance admins see, the one page everyone uses (their own expenses), how records flow into CSV exports, who sees what, and the order the pieces land in.
svg.text: Payroll and finance: how the pieces fit
· the directory’s visibility, inverted: money is visible to almost nobody
Where each piece lives, and where the money goes

g.text: Every endpoint behind one dependency; every field in its own response schema.

A batch, or a line on the next run.

The one finance page that is yours.
Submit with a receipt; see your own
The export is the product. Whatever moves
Approved runs and batches, shaped for a
Tax, withholding, filing and payment all
One flag, all or nothing: no view/edit/approve split and no per-department scoping, the same way team roles stayed two.

svg.text: Principles: integer minor units, currency per record, no conversion anywhere, per-currency subtotals. Append-only where it is a record, frozen where it is a decision: runs and
decided expenses snapshot amounts and department. State is set, not derived. Depends on #128 for departments, active accounts and the attachment pipeline.
